ITEM 1 | Two triangular wedge-shaped pieces of flatbread-like crust with pale cream-white melted topping, scattered reddish-brown browned spots and darker charred patches, golden-tan crust edges, slight sheen from melted cheese, soft-looking topping that holds its shape, sitting on a white square plate; larger piece about 9 cm long by 5 cm wide with a thickness of about 1 cm, smaller piece about 8 cm by 4 cm | 120

ITEM 2 | Tomato-based red-brown sauce spots visible as browned patches on top of the pale melted cheese topping, slightly glossy, sitting on and between the two wedge pieces; sauce covers a small fraction of the topping surface, roughly 1 cm dabs | 10
